source.author: lucan
source.text: Hic cum mihi semper in altum Surget et instabit summis minor Ursa ceruchis; Bosporon et Scythiae curvantem litora pontum Spectamus.
source.text_original: Hic cum mihi semper in altum / Surget et instabit summis minor Ursa ceruchis; / Bosporon et Scythiae curvantem litora pontum / Spectamus.
source.text_english: Here, while the Lesser Bear will always rise high above me and will stand over the highest masts, we shall look upon the Bosporus and the sea of Scythia, bending its shores.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: quin et Cecropiae proles vacat Orithyiae, temperet ut tremulos Zetes fraterque ceruchos.
reuse.text_original: quin et Cecropiae proles vacat Orithyiae, / temperet ut tremulos Zetes fraterque ceruchos.
reuse.text_english: Indeed, the offspring of Cecrops is also free from Orithyia, so that Zetes and his brother may restrain their trembling oars.
